The Unlikely Best Friends Let me tell you a story of a cow and a leopard from Vadodara in Gujarat who became friends. As you know, a leopard is a wild animal and a cow is a domestic animal. Some people say that the cow took care of the leopard cub like a mother. When the cub became older, it went away from the village. It returned to meet the cow at night. The villagers were worried but they never stopped the leopard. They saw that the leopard just sat beside the cow quietly. The cow and leopard spent time by relaxing and playing with each other. The leopard did not like the villagers and stopped coming regularly. The villagers were surprised that the leopard never attacked the cow but became its friend.

The Magic Chair Test

Mario's grandfather challenged him to a bet that he had no friends, but Mario used an invisible chair as a test. When he sat on the chair, his real friends Guneet, Asma, and Deepa held him up so he wouldn't fall, proving they were true friends.

True Friends vs. Companions

Mario's grandfather told Mario that many of the people in his school might just be companions or partners rather than real friends. True friends are those who care for you and help you when things go wrong.

Finding Real Friends

After sitting on the invisible chair, Mario saw his real friends holding him up. He learned that true friends are those who support you during difficult times, unlike people who only take joy in your bad luck.

The Magic Chair Test

Mario's grandfather challenged him to a bet that he had no friends, but Mario used an invisible chair as a test. When he sat on the chair, his real friends Guneet, Asma, and Deepa held him up so he wouldn't fall, proving they were true friends.

True Friends vs. Companions

Mario's grandfather told Mario that many of the people in his school might just be companions or partners rather than real friends. True friends are those who care for you and help you when things go wrong.

Finding Real Friends

After sitting on the invisible chair, Mario saw his real friends holding him up. He learned that true friends are those who support you during difficult times, unlike people who only take joy in your bad luck.
